title: A Living Forest
instruction: Restore the whole Forest Realm: macaque canopy West ↔ East, hornbill nest, frog stream site and 31 forest cells.
intro: The full regional map — North Canopy, both woodlands, the Central Clearing, the Shola Meadow and the River Edge. Both of your Living Charter amendments are in force.

events.title: Dry spell
events.text: A dry start to the season: 1 less capacity and no regrowth this round.

events.text: Lantana pushes into the canopy edge.

events.title: Monsoon run-off
events.text: Streamside cells still degraded at round end wash out.
